name: Global temperature
summary: Global temperature about 1.77°C above pre-industrial (27 Oct), past the 1.6°C line
state: ERA5 data for 27 Oct put the global surface air temperature 0.89°C above the 1991–2020 average, roughly 1.77°C above pre-industrial levels and past the 1.6°C Alert line, though not a record for the date. The strong El Niño is adding to long-term warming.
for_you: Higher global temperatures raise the odds of extreme heat, heavy rain and drought worldwide over the coming year.

sources.title: Climate Reanalyzer — Daily global surface air temperature (ERA5)

why: Global temperature is the master climate variable; each tenth of a degree raises extreme-weather risk.
drivers: Greenhouse gases, El Niño/La Niña, aerosols, solar cycle.

rubric.alert: > +1.6°C, or a record high for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Daily global anomaly < +1.3°C above pre-industrial (ERA5 vs 1991–2020 + 0.88°C).
